procedural_exemplar_value: Teaches multiple independently roof-rooted load paths, discontiguous primary level silhouettes, dense-island/low-bypass dual altitude grammars, unfilled edit-value staging and clipped ring access ports. All geometry is inert authored material cells, no scripted mechanisms.
similarity_avoidance: Unlike Meridian Scar's one fractured central clock, Ion Parapet's continuous stormbeam, Umbra Siphon's two horns, Pilgrim Gait's grounded walking hull and Tin Canticle's double dish chasm, this map distributes its silhouettes into FOUR staggered roof-suspended islands with open low return; the main landmark is a cableway plus one opened peripheral gimbal rather than a single central monument.
